faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: We answer your questions:
faq.contact_text: Other questions? Contact me directly here:

0.question: What types of clients do you support?
0.answer: We support entrepreneurs, influencer, startups and companies. Our projects range from conversion-oriented landing pages to more complete platforms (MVP, SaaS, dashboards), with an approach focused on design, solving problem, clarity of offer and performance.

1.question: How to get a quote and how long do you take to respond?
1.answer: Book a call or contact us directly on WhatsApp. We usually respond within 24h with a few quick questions and a first estimate. A detailed quote is then sent after a scoping exchange (objectives, content, deadlines, scope).

2.question: What happens if the design doesn't match your expectations?
2.answer: We move step by step with validations (creative direction, mockups, iterations). Each project includes revisions to adjust until we get a result aligned with your vision. The goal: a design that looks like you and converts.

3.question: What is the cost of a project?
3.answer: The budget depends on the scope (number of pages, features, animations, content, integrations). After a first exchange, we propose a clear recommendation with a transparent quote — no surprises.

4.question: Who is behind MC Studio?
4.answer: MC Studio brings together a team of 4 experts from different fields (product direction, design, frontend dev, backend dev and project management). Founded and led by Mohamed Chettah, the studio supports entrepreneurs, startups and companies from strategy to launch.

5.question: How does the collaboration work?
5.answer:
You will have a private WhatsApp channel with us to streamline exchanges, briefs and delivery. If needed, we schedule follow-up points.

Everything happens on Notion: you deposit your requests (text, video, docs), we analyze them and give you a deadline. In general, we deliver 2 to 3 tasks per week depending on complexity.

Once delivered, you validate or ask for revisions, then we move on to the next.

faq.subtitle: If you have more questions, we’ll cover them during our first call. The program’s framework is designed to be clear from day one.

0.question: Who can join the program?
0.answer:
The MC Studio Partner Program is open to anyone with a strong network: independents, freelancers, creatives, sales profiles, agencies, as well as your personal and professional network.

The key: understand our offers, recommend serious and qualified prospects, and maintain a professional posture.

1.question: How does the 10% commission work?
1.answer:
You introduce us to a prospect with a clear need in design, product or application development.
We talk directly with them, scope the need and send a proposal.

If the project is signed, you receive 10% of the total ex‑VAT amount billed on the first engagement (excluding renewals and any recurring subscriptions).

2.question: When is the commission paid?
2.answer:
The commission is paid as soon as the deposit has been received.

In practice, the payment happens right after signature.

3.question: Can I track my referrals and earnings?
3.answer:
Yes. Each partner benefits from a structured tracking system:
- list of prospects sent
- deal status (in progress, signed, not retained)
- amount of signed projects
- associated commissions.

You keep a clear and transparent view of the value you create.

4.question: Are there additional rewards?
4.answer:
Yes. On top of the 10% commission per signed project, we set up a tier system.

For instance, from 10 successful referrals onwards, you unlock a premium reward designed for the most engaged partners.

The goal: build a long-term, win‑win relationship.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything people ask us before starting a landing page.

0.question: I have no copy or content — is that a blocker?
0.answer: No. Structural copywriting is included: we write the hook, the benefits, the proof and the calls to action based on the framing call. All we need from you are the facts: your offer, pricing, references and photos if you have any.

1.question: 7 days, really?
1.answer: Yes, provided the brief is approved and your content is received at kick-off. The clock starts there. If your feedback takes longer, the schedule shifts accordingly — and we always tell you upfront.

2.question: What is the page built with?
2.answer: Two options depending on your needs. Custom code (Nuxt / Next.js) for performance and full control, or a no-code solution if you want to edit the page yourself easily. We decide together during the framing call.

3.question: Will I be able to edit the page myself?
3.answer: Yes. With no-code you edit directly. With custom code we can plug in a CMS for the content you want to manage. Just flag it during framing so it's planned from the design stage.

4.question: Are hosting and the domain name included?
4.answer: Launch is included. Hosting and the domain name stay in your name, so you keep ownership and control. Costs are low and we help you set them up.

5.question: What about SEO?
5.answer: Technical SEO is included: tag structure, content hierarchy, speed, responsiveness, sitemap. A full search strategy (keywords, content, backlinks) is ongoing work and is handled separately.

6.question: How many rounds of feedback do I get?
6.answer: As many as needed until the page is signed off. In practice two or three rounds are enough, because the structure and messaging are approved before the design starts.

7.question: How does payment work?
7.answer: 50% at kick-off to secure the slot, 50% on delivery before launch. Detailed quote and invoice provided, payment by bank transfer.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything people ask before starting a custom CRM.

0.question: How much does a custom CRM cost?
0.answer: The price depends on the number of modules, the integrations and how complex permissions are. That's why we don't quote a package before the audit. The framing session is free and leads to a fixed quote: you know exactly what you're paying before committing.

1.question: Why pay for development rather than a subscription?
1.answer: A per-user subscription costs more and more as the team grows, and you own nothing. A custom tool is a one-off investment: past a certain headcount or a certain level of business specificity, it becomes cheaper — and it belongs to you.

2.question: How long before we have something usable?
2.answer: Usually 4 to 8 weeks for a V1 in production, depending on scope. You see the tool running well before that: every batch ships to a test environment as development goes.

3.question: Can we bring our current data over?
3.answer: Yes. Excel, Google Sheets, an export from an old CRM: we analyse your files, clean up duplicates and import. The quality of the source files drives the workload, which is one of the things we look at during framing.

4.question: Where is the data hosted?
4.answer: On hosting located in Europe, with automatic backups and GDPR compliance. The database is in your name: you keep ownership and full access to your data.

5.question: Can it connect to our existing tools?
5.answer: Yes, as long as they expose an API: invoicing, accounting, email, calendar, e-signature, telephony. We list the required connections during framing so they're part of the quote.

6.question: Once it's delivered, who keeps it evolving?
6.answer: 30 days of fixes are included after go-live. After that, two options: changes on demand, quoted case by case, or a monthly retainer covering maintenance and continuous improvements.

7.question: Does it work on mobile?
7.answer: Yes. The app is responsive and designed for field teams from the mockups onwards. If the usage really calls for it (offline mode, native notifications, photos), we can also look into a dedicated mobile app.

final.title: Ready to get your processes out of spreadsheets?
final.subtitle: A 30-minute call is enough to understand how you work and tell you whether a custom tool makes sense for you.
